items.title: Darius Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 29, 2024
items.q: Darius was interviewed via Zoom on June 29, 2024 by Monk Rowe

ctx.x: Darius was interviewed via Zoom on June 29, 2024 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased to have Darius Brubeck with me this morning. And you are aware, you said you’re in a studio with your brother?
Yeah, my brother Chris. In Danbury, Connecticut.
